title: Miami Mint (Zero Nicotine) Geek Bar Pulse X 25000
description:
Miami Mint (Zero Nicotine) Geek Bar Pulse X 25000
A Refreshing Vaping Experience Awaits
Indulge in the cool, invigorating flavor of Miami Mint with the Geek Bar Pulse X 25000. Designed for those who crave a refreshing twist, this zero-nicotine disposable vape delivers a smooth, minty hit that awakens your senses with every puff.
Zero Nicotine, Infinite Enjoyment
Who says going nicotine-free means sacrificing flavor? The Geek Bar Pulse X 25000 proves otherwise. It’s perfect for those seeking a purely flavorful vaping experience without the buzz, making it your go-to for guilt-free enjoyment.
Disposable Convenience Meets Sleek Design
Say goodbye to charging or refilling hassles. This disposable vape is designed to seamlessly fit into your on-the-go lifestyle. Its ergonomic design ensures comfort while the visually sleek build exudes effortless style.
Key Features
Puff Count
:
Up to 25,000 (Regular Mode) or 15,000 (Pulse Mode)
E-liquid
:
18mL, 0% nicotine
Battery
:
820mAh rechargeable (USB-C)
Display
:
Smart 3D Curved LED Screen
Coils
:
Dual Mesh for superior flavor
Modes
:
Soft, Normal, Pulse
Airflow: Adjustable for customized draw
Flavor You’ll Keep Coming Back For
Miami Mint isn’t just a flavor; it’s a vibe. Cool, refreshing, and perfectly balanced, it’s like a tropical ocean breeze captured in a single puff. Whether you’re relaxing after a long day or stepping out with confidence, this flavor is your ultimate companion.
Elevate your vape game with the Miami Mint Geek Bar Pulse X 25000 and immerse yourself in the ultimate minty escape, wherever life takes you.
